title: PaginatedRateLimitEndpointSets
description: A list of rate limit endpoint sets.

links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

results.description: List of returned documents that MongoDB Cloud provides when completing this request.

totalCount.description: Total number of documents available. MongoDB Cloud omits this value if `includeCount` is set to `false`. The total number is an estimate and may not be exact.

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

RateLimitEndpointSetCapacity.description: The rate limit capacity for the endpoint set.

defaultValue.description: The default request capacity of the endpoint set. Returned if there is a capacity override set for the requested entity.

value.description: The applied request capacity of the endpoint set.

method.description: The HTTP method of the endpoint.

path.description: The URL path of the endpoint.

RateLimitEndpointSetRefillDurationSecond.description: The rate limit refill duration for the endpoint set.

defaultValue.description: The default rate limit refill duration, in seconds, of the endpoint set. Returned if there is a rate limit refill duration override set for the requested entity.

value.description: The applied rate limit refill duration of the endpoint set.

RateLimitEndpointSetRefillRate.description: The rate limit refill rate for the endpoint set.

defaultValue.description: The default rate limit refill rate of the endpoint set. Returned if there is a rate limit refill rate override set for the requested entity.

value.description: The applied rate limit refill rate of the endpoint set.

endpointSetId.description: The ID of the endpoint set.

endpoints.description: A list of endpoints associated with the specified endpoint set.

scope.description: The scope of the endpoint set.
